# OAAP CLI reference (generated)

Every command of reference 0.1.260, generated from the parser by `oaap help --markdown`. Examples, warnings and the reasons behind a command are in the [hand-written CLI reference](../README.md).

## Commands of the wrapper

| Command | Needs `sudo` | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `oaap status` | no | node health without the portal: version, profiles, core services, apps, host care, disk; ends HEALTHY or DEGRADED (exit 1) |
| `oaap version` | no | the installed platform version |
| `sudo oaap setup-token` | yes | URL and one-time token to create the first admin, until setup is done |
| `sudo oaap update [--check]` | yes | update the platform from Git (--check: only say whether there is a newer version) |
| `sudo oaap uninstall [--purge] [--yes]` | yes | remove the platform from this node; --purge also deletes all data |

|---|---|---|
| [`oaap authz`](authz.md) | yes | business authorization -- roles, collections, assignments (oaap.core.authorization) |

| [`oaap files`](files.md) | yes | the byte store of RFC-0034 (Stufe 1, local) |
| [`oaap fleet`](fleet.md) | yes | fleet keys: read-only /fleet/status access (RFC-0021) |

| [`oaap mail`](mail.md) | yes | the node's mailbox: realms send password resets with it (RFC-0072) |

## Instances and apps (`oaap app ...`)

| Command | Needs `sudo` | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`oaap app access`](app-access.md) | yes | a time-boxed access into one instance network (RFC-0044). 'wireguard' needs node profile 'remote-access' and its firewall fence is not measured on a real node yet |
| [`oaap app address`](app-address.md) | yes | an instance's own public hostname and its aliases (RFC-0009, RFC-0018) |
| [`oaap app artifact`](app-artifact.md) | yes | uploaded packages (RFC-0019) |
| [`oaap app bulk`](app-bulk.md) | yes | update, promote or rebuild everything that is due, one after another, stopping at the first failure |
| [`oaap app config`](app-config.md) | yes | list, set or unset the configuration values of an instance |
| [`oaap app convert`](app-convert.md) | no | turn a docker-compose file into an OAAP package draft |
| [`oaap app diagnose`](app-diagnose.md) | yes | the portal's diagnosis window, from the machine (RFC-0038 D2) |
| [`oaap app endpoint`](app-endpoint.md) | yes | non-HTTP endpoints (RFC-0015) |
| [`oaap app grant`](app-grant.md) | yes | open instance creation grants (RFC-0019) |
| [`oaap app install`](app-install.md) | yes | install an app package as a new instance, or redeploy an existing one |
| [`oaap app instance-keys`](app-instance-keys.md) | yes | the platform's keys of each instance (RFC-0062): renew those that expire soon, or clear orphans |
| [`oaap app link`](app-link.md) | yes | app-to-app links (RFC-0016) |
| [`oaap app list`](app-list.md) | yes | list the app instances of this node |
| [`oaap app logs`](app-logs.md) | yes | show an instance's container log (RFC-0038) |
| [`oaap app maintenance`](app-maintenance.md) | yes | only administrators pass; everybody else sees a 'back soon' page (RFC-0059) |
| [`oaap app promote`](app-promote.md) | yes | ship the tested artifact to production (RFC-0020) |
| [`oaap app purge`](app-purge.md) | yes | delete data left behind by a removed instance |
| [`oaap app rebuild`](app-rebuild.md) | yes | build an instance again on a freshly pulled base, falling back to the previous image (RFC-0071) |
| [`oaap app rehearsal`](app-rehearsal.md) | yes | list, extend or end rehearsals (RFC-0030) |
| [`oaap app rehearse`](app-rehearse.md) | yes | build a rehearsal: the test instance's code on a copy of production data (RFC-0030) |
| [`oaap app remove`](app-remove.md) | yes | remove an instance (--purge also deletes its data) |
| [`oaap app rename`](app-rename.md) | yes | give an instance a different name (RFC-0026) |
| [`oaap app resources`](app-resources.md) | yes | show or set memory, CPU and process limits of an instance (RFC-0046) |
| [`oaap app restart`](app-restart.md) | yes | recreate an instance's containers (RFC-0038 D4) |
| [`oaap app standby`](app-standby.md) | yes | put an instance to sleep: containers stopped, data kept, stays asleep over update and reboot (RFC-0059) |
| [`oaap app standby-after`](app-standby-after.md) | yes | let an unused instance go to sleep by itself after N minutes, or 'off' (RFC-0059 stage 3) |
| [`oaap app throttle`](app-throttle.md) | yes | request limit per client address of an instance (RFC-0010) |
| [`oaap app tile`](app-tile.md) | yes | whether an instance shows a tile in the launchpad |
| [`oaap app token`](app-token.md) | yes | deploy tokens of an instance: create, list, revoke |
| [`oaap app visibility`](app-visibility.md) | yes | who sees an instance: everybody, or only some groups (RFC-0007) |
| [`oaap app wake`](app-wake.md) | yes | start a sleeping instance (RFC-0059) |

## Internal

Called by update, install, the portal or a timer; listed so they can be recognised, not to be typed.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`oaap app artifact-index`](app-artifact-index.md) | list retained packages where the portal can read them (oaap.apps.runtime 2.14) |
| [`oaap app config-index`](app-config-index.md) | write non-secret config values where the portal can read them (portal 2.4) |
| [`oaap app egress-faults`](app-egress-faults.md) | the line of closed egress for 'oaap status' |
| [`oaap app egress-sweep`](app-egress-sweep.md) | stop closed instances that are not closed in fact (RFC-0068) |
| [`oaap app migrate-care-url`](app-migrate-care-url.md) | the care door listener and OAAP_CARE_URL for every instance (0.1.223, RFC-0069 stage 3) |
| [`oaap app migrate-connect`](app-migrate-connect.md) | prepare the tunnel's directories and route (called by update) |
| [`oaap app migrate-identity-headers`](app-migrate-identity-headers.md) | carry RFC-0040's identity headers into sites written before 0.1.107 |
| [`oaap app migrate-idp-dir`](app-migrate-idp-dir.md) | prepare the 0600 directory the identity service mounts for provider secrets (RFC-0041) |
| [`oaap app migrate-instance-dirs`](app-migrate-instance-dirs.md) | move instance data under its tenant (RFC-0026) |
| [`oaap app migrate-instance-keys`](app-migrate-instance-keys.md) | retire keys, principals and authorization records of instances that no longer exist (RFC-0062 D4) |
| [`oaap app migrate-networks`](app-migrate-networks.md) | isolate app networks + reconnect the gateway (RFC-0016) |
| [`oaap app migrate-place-assets`](app-migrate-place-assets.md) | write every tenant logo where the gateway serves it (RFC-0042 T3) |
| [`oaap app migrate-platform-routes`](app-migrate-platform-routes.md) | reserve /platform/* on instance sites written before 0.1.199 (RFC-0061) |
| [`oaap app migrate-retained`](app-migrate-retained.md) | drop 'left behind' notes about data an installed instance is using |
| [`oaap app migrate-stream-close`](app-migrate-stream-close.md) | keep open streams alive across gateway reloads in sites written before 0.1.102 |
| [`oaap app migrate-tenant-places`](app-migrate-tenant-places.md) | give each tenant its address <label>.<node> (RFC-0042 T1/T2) |
| [`oaap app migrate-tenant-routes`](app-migrate-tenant-routes.md) | put the tenant boundary into gateway sites written before oaap.core.tenant 0.2 |
| [`oaap app migrate-tenants`](app-migrate-tenants.md) | create the default tenant and stamp what belongs to it (RFC-0022 stage 2) |
| [`oaap app process-deploys`](app-process-deploys.md) | work the deploy spool (called by the path unit and the portal) |
| [`oaap app rehearsal-index`](app-rehearsal-index.md) | measure what a rehearsal would cost, where the portal can read it (spec 2.15) |
| [`oaap app restore-instances`](app-restore-instances.md) | bring instances back after a restore (called by install) |
| [`oaap app scrub-access-log`](app-scrub-access-log.md) | filter access-log lines written before 0.1.103 (once per node) |
| [`oaap app state-index`](app-state-index.md) | write container state facts where the portal can read them (RFC-0038 D1) |
| [`oaap app support-cleanup-note`](app-support-cleanup-note.md) | name the accounts still holding both 'partner' and 'support' (RFC-0039) |
